# CUIT 校园网 (CUITNet)

> CUITNet is a free, open-source (MIT) auto-login tool for the campus network of Chengdu University of Information Technology (CUIT, 成都信息工程大学): a native macOS menu bar app and a native Windows tray app that sign in to the campus portal over plain HTTP (no browser, no Selenium) and reconnect when the connection drops. 成都信息工程大学校园网自动登录工具，macOS 与 Windows 原生应用，掉线自动重连。

Key facts:

- Website: https://hoobnn.github.io/cuit-campus-login/
- Source code: https://github.com/hoobnn/cuit-campus-login
- Download: https://github.com/hoobnn/cuit-campus-login/releases/latest (macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel, signed and notarized; Windows 10 1809+ x64, not code-signed)
- Install on macOS: `brew install --cask hoobnn/tap/cuitnet`
- Price and license: free, MIT.
- Portal: Ruijie SAM 5.x with CAS single sign-on, CUIT only; other universities are not guaranteed to work.
- Features: carrier selection (China Mobile / Telecom / Unicom), background online check with backoff, stops retrying after a wrong password to avoid lockout, bypasses system proxies such as Clash, notifications, launch at login.
- Credentials: macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager.
- Status: protocol follows community reverse-engineering and is tested against a local fake portal; not yet verified against the real portal.
- Author: hoobnn (https://github.com/hoobnn, https://www.ikuyu.com)
